incomplete.description: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds
Ensure that elements labelled through their content must have their visible text as part of their accessible name

eaaContext.note: The EU European Accessibility Act (EAA) commonly references WCAG 2.1 AA / EN 301 549. This Actor reports axe-core findings for WCAG-oriented tags to support readiness reviews.

disclaimer: Informational automated scan only (static HTML via jsdom + axe-core). Not a legal compliance certificate, accessibility audit sign-off, or guarantee of WCAG/EAA conformance. JS-rendered content and some contrast/keyboard checks need a real browser and human review.
